summary: Verified CPM ID (Calon Penerima Manfaat) generation, persistence, and new right-side header UI for student vs admin. All 5 backend pytest tests passed and every frontend acceptance criterion in the review request was met on desktop and mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1370 lines — consider splitting per feature (auth, registration, documents, admin) for maintainability.

GET /api/registration is called by both students and admins; currently admins receive an empty {} which is fine, but a role-guard would be cleaner and prevent accidental counter increments in edge cases.

ensure_cpm_id increments the yearly counter only when a legacy registration lacks cpm_id; the -1 offset via find_one_and_update+$inc works but is fragile. Consider using find_one_and_update with $setOnInsert + upsert for atomic first-value=0 semantics.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend cpm regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_cpm_registration.py covers: cpm_id format, stability across GETs, stability across POST draft, exact CPM-MDJ/2026/000000 for demo student, and that admin GET /api/registration returns no cpm_id. Frontend: student header uses CandidateIdentity (bell + red dot + 'Calon Penerima Manfaat' + 'ID: CPM-MDJ/YYYY/NNNNNN' + avatar with pas foto). Mobile hides identity text (display:none via sm:block) while keeping bell+avatar; no horizontal overflow at 390px. Admin retains regular AccountIdentity — no CPM formatting. Note: student post-login route is /dashboard (not /student) — role-aware routing works.
